analysis: All changed files are test-only Swift sources under provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/Inference/Distributed. ClusterApprovalFixture.swift (head lines 311-326) adds the extension method startedLeaderService(powerAssertionReason:), which was extracted verbatim from ClusterServiceRestartingStopTests.service (base lines 31-45). ClusterServiceRestartingStopTests.swift line 32 now delegates to that method. The extraction preserves the dry-run LiveSettings, the /usr/bin/true executable and a unique power-assertion reason. ClusterOnboardingStopsAskedTests.swift is new and tests the stops-asked counter, reply and request codec backward compatibility, and the rule that a start never undoes a stop asked since it began. No production code is in this batch. The fixtures use private temp roots, a loopback ws://127.0.0.1:9 coordinator URL, a software signer, and fake secrets (a 32-byte constant 7, written 0600). No real credentials, endpoints or SE keys are touched. None of the changes alter the provider-coordinator wire contract, the attestation or App Attest authorization (TB-011), the prefix cache (T-041), or the add-on hold socket (TB-012). Tests that assert the intended behavior of the production change (stopsAsked, stopsBefore, localServe(unlessStoppedSince:)) cannot be reviewed for correctness here because the production implementation (OnboardingLive.recordStop, ClusterControlReply, ClusterOnboardingStopped) is not in the supplied evidence. The next pass should check that the production counter cannot be reset or spoofed by an unauthenticated peer message, and that stopsBefore from an older or hostile peer cannot cause a start to undo a person's stop. The base_text unit for ClusterServiceRestartingStopTests was truncated at line 422, which is a coverage limit; the patch shows only the service() helper change.
